targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "smart_device" and r._field == "health_ok")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "device", "model", "_value"])
  |> group()

from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "smart_device" and r._field == "temp_c")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " " + r.device}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Failure-predicting SMART attributes (raw values; should be 0)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "smart_attribute" and r._field == "raw_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /Reallocated_Sector_Ct|Current_Pending_Sector|Offline_Uncorrectable|Reported_Uncorrect|UDMA_CRC_Error_Count/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.name}))
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "device", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " " + r.path}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "_time"])

from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zpool" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " " + r.pool + " (" + r.health + ")"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "_time"])
